get.description: Every account on this server, the admin first. Admin only.

schema.title: Response List Accounts Api V1 Accounts Get

delete.description:
Remove a member and delete everything they own: seeds, presets, Switches,
passkeys and paired devices. Refused while one of their jobs runs. Admin only.

get.description: The verified `.nro` from `/app/latest`.

The latest Switch app release this server has verified (its SHA-256 and its
build-provenance attestation), and the oldest app version it works with.

post.description: Finish signing in with the browser's passkey response.
Start signing in with a passkey. No username is needed: the passkey says who.

get.description: Who is signed in. Returns 401 when nobody is.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api V1 Devices Get

delete.description: Unpair the device making this request; its token stops working.

get.description: The device making this request (for the Switch app to check its pairing).

post.description: Exchange a pairing code for a device token. Called by the Switch app.
A one-time code for pairing the Switch app with this account.

delete.description: Revoke a device: its token stops working at once.

get.description: Server name and version.
Invites that haven't been used, revoked or expired. Admin only.

schema.title: Response List Invites Api V1 Invites Get

post.description: A one-time invite link, valid for 7 days. Admin only.
Create an account with an invite link's token, and sign in to it.

delete.description: Revoke an unused invite: its link stops working. Admin only.
Cancel a queued or running job.

get.description: Live progress as Server-Sent Events: one `job` event per change, until it finishes.

schema.title: Response List Passkeys Api V1 Passkeys Get

post.description: Save the passkey the browser just created.
Start adding a passkey for the signed-in user.

delete.description: Remove a passkey. Password sign-in always remains.

get.description: Randovania's bundled Dread presets, then the user's imported ones.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api V1 Presets Get

post.description: Import a `.rdvpreset` file. Send the file's JSON as the request body (max 1 MB).

delete.description: Delete an imported preset. Bundled presets can't be deleted.

put.description:
Replace one of your presets with a whole `.rdvpreset` (max 1 MB).

Randovania checks it first; if it refuses, nothing changes. Bundled presets
can't be changed: copy one first.

post.description: Copy any preset into a new one of yours, to edit (ADR 0019).

get.description: Download a preset as a `.rdvpreset`, to open in Randovania's desktop app.

Whether the server has usable game files (an extracted RomFS), and which version.

For an invited account this is always `missing`: the server's game files are
the admin's own, and each account will upload its own (ADR 0020 §3).
The current (or last) game files upload.

post.description:
Start uploading an archive (zip or tar) of an extracted RomFS, or resume the same file.

Then send it in chunks with `PATCH`, and install it with `POST …/install`.

delete.description: Discard an upload and the data received so far.

patch.description:
Append one chunk (at most `chunk_size` bytes) at `Upload-Offset`.

A 409 with `offset` means the server has a different amount: continue from there.

parameters.description: Where this chunk starts: the upload's current offset.
parameters.name: Upload-Offset

post.description:
Check, extract and validate the uploaded archive, then replace the game files with it.

Runs in the background: follow it with `GET /romfs/upload`. The current game
files are only replaced if the new ones are a supported, unmodified RomFS.

get.description: Newest first.

schema.title: Response List Seeds Api V1 Seeds Get

post.description: Start generating a seed from a preset or a permalink. Follow the job for progress.
Delete all seeds, or all older than N days. The scope must be explicit.

delete.description: Delete a seed's patched files to free space. The seed itself is kept.

post.description:
Patch a generated seed into the server's game files. Follow the job for progress.

Needs ready game files (see `GET /romfs`). Race seeds can be patched: patching
doesn't reveal the spoiler.

get.description:
The patched seed as one uncompressed ustar archive, for the Switch app (ADR 0018).

Members are `atmosphere/…`, in the order /mod/manifest lists them.

Download the patched seed as a zip. Extract it at the root of the SD card.

It contains `atmosphere/…`, made from your own game files: don't share it.
The patched seed's files with their sizes and SHA-256, for the Switch app (ADR 0018).

post.description:
Install a patched seed on a saved Switch over FTP. Open ftpd on the Switch first.

The previous seed's files are removed first; other mods are kept. If the seed
would replace another mod's files, the job fails and lists them, unless
`overwrite` is set. Follow the job for progress.

get.description: Download the `.rdvgame`. For non-race seeds, this file contains the spoiler.
Where every pickup is. A separate request, so the UI can require a reveal step.
Whether first-run setup is still needed. Reveals nothing else.

post.description: Create the first account with the one-time setup token from the server log.

get.description: Your saved Switches. Passwords are never included.

schema.title: Response List Switches Api V1 Switches Get

post.description: Save a Switch running ftpd on your local network (public addresses are refused).

patch.description: Change a Switch. Fields left out are kept, including the password.

post.description:
Log in to ftpd on the Switch and check for the Atmosphere folder.

Open ftpd on the Switch first. Takes up to about ten seconds if it doesn't answer.

get.description: Liveness check for Docker and reverse proxies.
